common_round_stop: Stop all four matched continuations when any cell exhausts patience or has persistent regression; retain every intermediate state and select its best guarded development checkpoint separately per cell, never per door.
training_only_improvement: If a cell's own training objective improves but its inferred development action score does not, diagnose data and behavior before another round; do not compare ACT loss with Diffusion MSE.
A1_metric: Mean over phase/lighting buckets of per-action L2 joint-delta error in radians.
A2_metric: Mean over phase/lighting buckets of max(translation error/0.01m, relative SO3 rotation error/(5degrees)); component errors also retained.
effect_size_rationale: A fixed paired inference suite and seed remove changing-sample noise; require baseline repeat agreement within0.1percent. A5percent reduction is a practical effect threshold well above numerical repeat differences. Balanced phases prevent85percent push exposure from hiding hold/release regressions. This is not a confidence bound, vision-accuracy requirement or physical success threshold.
development_limit: Two lighting variants of one identical motion, not independent trajectories or unseen-door closed-loop evidence. Local inference only; no weights or normalization updates.
completion: After selection verify one actual maintained integrated execution, then freeze one checkpoint per cell and the common final24 protocol; preserve all outcomes by version, including unfavorable executions.
